data: Fictional tasks and private notes in isolated local SQLite instances

cases.flow: Create a task, open Kanban, drag the task into Doing, verify the destination and focus on it
cases.retakeChange: Replace Draft launch announcement with Review launch checklist in values and targets

cases.flow: Write a rich-text memo, save it, search for a phrase and focus on the result
cases.retakeChange: Replace check keyboard navigation with verify mobile layout in content and search targets

verification.preview: Both full flows succeeded in headless preview
verification.recording: Two successful recordings per application using the same saved login state and step structure
verification.rendering: Every take produced landscape and portrait MP4, GIF and posters
verification.decode: All 16 MP4/GIF outputs passed complete FFmpeg decoding
verification.visualReview: Sampled midpoint frames and result posters inspected

limitations: The upstream apps were tested on Windows only; repository CI tests use controlled fixtures
Stories use English UI labels, disposable state and the pinned upstream versions
Vikunja drag uses a fixed 316-pixel offset at a 1280x800 viewport
Desktop text remains small in portrait; landscape can crop peripheral header content
App data persisted between takes; unique fictional values distinguish the retake
This verifies maintainer execution and repeatability, with external user adoption still unmeasured
